description: The Todo application allows a user to submit the Add Task form without entering any task text. An empty task is then added to the Added Task list.
reproduction_steps: Open the Todo application at http://localhost:3000
Leave the Add New Task input empty
actual_result: An empty task is added to the Added Task list.
expected_result: An empty task should not be added to the Added Task list.
verification_method: Reproduce the same user action after the fix and confirm that an empty task is no longer created.
